title: Metrocentre visitor guide concept
summary: A mobile-first independent concept showing a searchable four-place documentary sample, saved places and links to official visitor information.
notice: Independent concept demonstration. Not commissioned or endorsed by Metrocentre. Metrocentre is not represented as a customer.

features.name: Indoor map
features.description: No indoor map is included. The destination screen explicitly shows an unavailable map preview and disabled floor controls. A verified and authorised floor plan is required.

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Visit planning is a concept with a destination summary and an external link to the official centre map. No route calculation, indoor positioning, directions or automatic destination transfer is implemented.

features.name: Inventory management
features.description: Proposed future inventory integration, subject to authorised retailer data and a separately agreed scope. No stock availability or inventory management is implemented.

features.name: Advertising
features.description: Proposed future advertising capability, subject to commercial agreement and content approval. No advertising system or paid campaigns are implemented.
